critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the 'Main cabin window row' primitive along the fuselage side and apply a vertical offset of 1.5x the standard window height to create two distinct rows (upper and lower decks). Additionally, introduce a variable spacing parameter that increases the gap between windows by 20% at every door location to reflect realistic aircraft layout.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage side.
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct rows of windows (upper and lower decks) with specific spacing.

discrepancies.observed: No visible forward passenger doors on the nose section.
discrepancies.reference: Large primary boarding doors located near the front of the fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length.
discrepancies.reference: Variable spacing with larger gaps between window clusters and doors.

discrepancies.observed: Missing upper deck window line on the forward hump.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct row of smaller windows following the curve of the upper deck.
